persona.label: Busy, wants a callback
persona.description: At work and won't do it by text. Wants a call tomorrow after 5pm. Agent should book a callback, not push.
persona.behavior: You are a nurse on shift and can't text right now. Your first reply is "at work, can't do this now." If offered options, ask for someone to call you tomorrow after 5pm. Don't answer qualification questions by text; if pressed, say "I'd rather just talk tomorrow." Once a callback is confirmed, say thanks and stop replying.

transcript.text: Hi Sam, this is Riley, an automated assistant with Harborline Home Loans, following up on the refinance inquiry you just submitted. Is now a good time for a few quick questions? You can reply STOP at any time.
at work, can't do this now.
Understood, Sam. I can either ask 2-3 quick questions by text now, or set up a call with a loan officer at a time that works for you. Which do you prefer?
can someone call me tomorrow after 5pm?
I've booked your call. A licensed loan officer from Harborline will call you at this number tomorrow (Thursday) after 5pm.

events.name: schedule_callback

input.notes: Borrower at work, requested callback. Refinance inquiry via web; no qualification details collected yet (goal, home value, balance, rate, credit, occupancy, timeline all unknown).

events.result: Callback booked. In one short message, confirm the time and say a licensed loan officer will call. Then close.

callback.notes: Borrower at work, requested callback. Refinance inquiry via web; no qualification details collected yet (goal, home value, balance, rate, credit, occupancy, timeline all unknown).

objections.rationale: Agent followed the playbook exactly: "I can either ask 2-3 quick questions by text now, or set up a call with a loan officer at a time that works for you." Then it scheduled the requested time and closed without pushing.

judge.naturalness_rationale: Messages are brief, warm, and adapted to the borrower ("Understood, Sam."). Offering the text-questions option to someone who just said "can't do this now" reads slightly scripted. The close lacks a polite sign-off like "thanks" or "have a good day."
judge.experience_rationale: The borrower's busy status was respected and the callback was booked quickly. Turn 4 states who will call ("A licensed loan officer from Harborline"), how ("at this number"), and when ("tomorrow (Thursday) after 5pm").

annotations.note: Discloses AI identity ("an automated assistant"), states the reason for contact, and gives STOP opt-out up front.
Offers the two playbook options clearly and briefly without pressuring the busy borrower.
Confirmation names who, how, and when, and clarifies "tomorrow" as "(Thursday)" to avoid ambiguity.
Ends abruptly with no thanks or closing courtesy, which feels slightly curt for someone at work.

judge.overall_notes: Clean, compliant handling of a busy borrower with a fast, clear callback confirmation. Only minor polish is missing in the closing courtesy.
